## Summary

Describe the focused change and the user-visible outcome.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] Processing remains local unless an explicit, documented boundary changed.
- [ ] Tests and fixtures contain only synthetic, non-sensitive data.
- [ ] Mutation paths preserve the source, bounds, and reanalysis guarantees.
- [ ] New heuristics do not claim authorship, provider attribution, or certainty.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under MPL-2.0.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] `./quality-gate.sh` passes, or I documented why it cannot run here.
- [ ] I manually checked relevant UI and accessibility behavior.
